      <title>Software Developer</title>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;ABOUT SKJOLDET&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;We are a Danish fintech startup turning the approach to digital fraud on its head. Imagine being able to convert a phishing site into a signal that could stop everyone from losing money to that exact scam. That's what we're working on. And why? We witnessed first-hand how digital fraud hits ordinary people, especially those close to us, costing them both time and money. We decided to do something about it. Instead of reacting to fraud after the fact, we stop it proactively, outside the bank's systems, before the payment goes through. We are a small, ambitious team of two founders, developers and analysts, entering a new chapter of investment and scaling.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;YOUR ROLE&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;As our Software Developer, you'll be an important part of a small, hands-on technical team – contributing to real features, learning from experienced developers, and helping build systems that detect fraud before money is lost. You'll work closely with our CTO and the rest of the team, and from day one your work will have a real impact.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Build and maintain features across our backend and frontend systems&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Work on real-time data pipelines that process fraud signals at scale&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Collaborate with fraud analysts and developers to turn data into actionable prevention&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Write clean, reliable code and learn to take ownership of your contributions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Grow your skills in a production environment with meaningful, complex problems&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;TECH STACK&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;TypeScript / JavaScript · Node.js · MongoDB / NoSQL · React · AI / ML&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WHAT YOU BRING&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;We're not just hiring your CV. We're hiring your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your drive to build things that actually matter.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;A degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field or equivalent practical experience&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript and a desire to go deeper&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Some experience with backend development, whether from jobs, studies, projects or internships&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Comfortable learning new technologies and asking questions when you're stuck&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Interest in AI/ML and how data can be used to solve real-world problems&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Eager to grow in a startup environment where you take real ownership&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Experience from fintech, finance or regulated environments is a plus – but far from required&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WE OFFER&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;A real engineering role – not just support tasks – in a fintech startup with European ambitions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Collaboration with experienced developers and the founding team&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, finance and security from day one&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;Flexible, trust-based work culture in Lyngby&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span&gt;The chance to grow fast and help build something that doesn't exist yet&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;</description>
